title: Vetting checks passed on default input values when no archive query had run
what_happened: Before commits 7d3702f (infrared) and 0e5956a (light curve), live enrichment filled vetting inputs with benign defaults when no archive query supplied them (for example n_neighbours_gaia_xmatch=1, cirrus_bg_rms_mjy=0.4, galex_uv_excess_mag=0.0, xray_luminosity_erg_s=0.0, rv_scatter_kms=0.3, nss_flag=0), and several light-curve checks read fixture-only flags. Checks then reported pass on those defaults, so a pass row did not show that the archive had been queried. This applied to the live candidates, including 5628404318169472.
generic_lesson: A vetting check may report pass or fail only from data that a recorded query returned. Live enrichment records the outcome of every query in vetting_archive.query_status; when the query did not run or failed, the check reports not_evaluated and names the missing query, and a stale input value is not used.
automated_check: vetting_archive.query_status rule in oddstar.vet.ir_checks and oddstar.vet.lc_checks (missing or failed query -> not_evaluated)
